findings.description: Positive: Moving flat-module isolation from skills/tests/conftest.py to skills/conftest.py correctly extends pytest hook coverage to both tests/<skill>/ and <skill>/scripts/tests trees in one shared process, which matches the failure mode (script-level suites poisoned by later tests/ imports).

Positive: _suite_for now distinguishes tests/<leaf>, <skill>/scripts/tests, and <skill>/tests layouts, and leaf extraction via suite.split('/', 1)[-1] keeps dependency lookup keyed by skill name for both suite id shapes.

_SCRIPT_DEPENDENCIES gained 'refresh-architecture': ('project-context-runtime',) which was absent from the previous tests/conftest map. The new isolation repro explicitly pairs refresh-architecture/scripts/tests with tests/roadmap-runtime; without this edge, adapter imports can still resolve the wrong flat modules after suite switches. Confirm this is intentional and complete versus other script-level suites that import foreign flat modules.

Positive: work-packages.yaml adds skills/conftest.py to the package path allowlist alongside skills/tests/conftest.py, so the relocated hook file stays inside declared ri-06 scope rather than becoming an undeclared out-of-package edit.

Positive: Dedicated isolation coverage now includes the exact post-validation failure shape (scripts/tests then tests/) via subprocess pytest pairs, and reported evidence (2 reds green, isolation 3 passed, infrastructure 4775 passed / 13 skipped, Ruff clean) supports the fix under full-suite load.

skills/tests/conftest.py is reduced to a pointer docstring with no hooks. That is compatible while skills/conftest.py remains loaded, but a future collector that only loads the tests/ tree conftest (or deletes the root file without restoring hooks) would silently lose isolation. Consider a one-line re-export or explicit comment that deletion is unsafe, or a guard test that skills/conftest.py defines pytest_collectstart/pytest_runtest_setup.

_SCRIPT_DEPENDENCIES remains a manually maintained adjacency list duplicated in spirit across skill coupling. Adding refresh-architecture is correct for this bug, but growth of scripts/tests suites will keep requiring hand updates; no automated completeness check exists. Acceptable for this isolation hotfix; track as follow-up if more cross-skill flat imports appear.
